newsitem.title: USA: Raymond, BT clear antitrust wait.
newsitem.headline: Raymond, BT clear antitrust wait.

text.p: Raymond Corp and BT Industries AB said Wednesday that the 15-day waiting period under the Hart-Scott-Rodino Antitrust Improvements Act expired on July 5.
The waiting period ended without a request for further information or documentary material by the U.S. Department of Justice or the Federal Trade Commission, the companies said.
The companies announced a merger pact in June under which BT Industries of Sweden agreed to buy Raymond for $33 per share in cash.
A tender offer for all outstanding Raymond shares, being conducted by BT unit Lift Acquisition Co Inc, is expected to expire on July 18 unless extended, the companies said.
